sloka: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः ।तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत् ॥४-११-४५॥।।
transliteration: vyāpāravīryadhairyaiśca parikṣīṇaṁ parākramaiḥ ।taṁ tu dundubhimudyamya dharaṇyāmabhyapātayat ॥4-11-45॥।।

translations.english: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.
